stages.stage: grasp the teapot by its handle
stages.goal: The gripper closes on the teapot's handle at teapot.handle_center, with the teapot still upright at its spawn pose.

point_choice.pointer: grasp the teapot by its handle.point.teapot

stages.goal: Carry the teapot upright until teapot.handle_center sits roughly over mug.opening_center and well above the mug rim, with teapot.+up still pointing the way world.z points.

rows.text: above mug.opening_center, clearance large, slack moderate

points_at_goal.relative_to: w origin (mug's selected point), height along mug up

stages.stage: tilt the teapot to pour into the mug
stages.goal: The teapot tips forward about its lateral (tilt) axis until teapot.+front, the spout direction, points the way mug.-up points, with teapot.spout_tip held centered above mug.opening_center so the tea falls into the mug.
